pick.headline: President Bush arrives in Poland
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of July 10, 1989, carried Warsaw PAP's report of Bush's pre-trip press conference, where he said he was going to Poland to encourage reform, not "to drive a wedge" between Moscow and Eastern Europe, under the heading of his arrival in Warsaw.

alternates.headline: Pyongyang announces Kim Il-song's death
alternates.fbis: The East Asia Daily Report of July 12, 1994, carried Seoul YONHAP reports relaying North Korean news-agency accounts of citizens flocking to Kim Il-song's statues and broadcasts casting Kim Chong-il as the new leader, plus Seoul-Washington consultations after the death.
